building_blocks.name: Bootstrap
building_blocks.purpose: Create a restartable project baseline from an initial problem-owner input without requiring technical setup knowledge.

building_blocks.name: Canonical State
building_blocks.purpose: Persist accepted project knowledge, requirements, decisions and current state outside chat.

building_blocks.name: Context Compiler
building_blocks.purpose: Compile task-relevant objective, state, evidence, methods, authority and constraints for AI/human work.

building_blocks.name: Competence Discovery
building_blocks.purpose: Detect domain, method, project, technical and interface competencies needed for a material question.

building_blocks.name: SOTA and Fit Research
building_blocks.purpose: Research current state of the art, best practice, standards and comparable approaches, then assess project-specific fit.

building_blocks.name: Systemic Integration
building_blocks.purpose: Interpret new aspects against the whole system and disposition them as fuse/refine/reframe/supersede/conflict/reject/defer rather than append them blindly.

building_blocks.name: Requirements and Criteria
building_blocks.purpose: Translate validated needs into traceable requirements, acceptance criteria and verification methods.

building_blocks.name: Concept and Architecture
building_blocks.purpose: Develop and compare domain/technical solution concepts from accepted requirements, including data, backend, ML/AI, infrastructure and DevOps when justified.

building_blocks.name: Implementation
building_blocks.purpose: Implement the selected solution with the simplest adequate stack; the result may be knowledge artifacts or pure software without AI.

building_blocks.name: Assurance
building_blocks.purpose: Separate deterministic validation, procedural assurance, AI review, specialist review and human acceptance.

building_blocks.name: Trace and Explain
building_blocks.purpose: Explain what exists, what changed, why, based on what, with which authority and consequences.

building_blocks.name: Derived Views
building_blocks.purpose: Generate human-readable current-state, handoff, coverage, risk and audit views from canonical sources without creating parallel truth.

building_blocks.name: Operations and DevOps
building_blocks.purpose: Keep required project/product operations running through CI/CD, dependency maintenance, backup/recovery, deployment, observability and security only as needs justify them.

building_blocks.name: Use and Learn
building_blocks.purpose: Feed real owner/domain usage and failures back into problem understanding, requirements, regressions and architecture without novelty-driven drift.

composition_principles: Building blocks are capabilities, not mandatory folders, agents or services.
A project instantiates only the blocks needed by its lifecycle and outcome.
Blocks share traceable state but must not create duplicate truth stores.
Automation is maximized for routine and operational necessity; material human choices remain explicit.
New generic blocks require evidence from repeated real project friction, not architecture speculation.
